'''Gallifrey Lane''' was located in [[Sector 2-12]] of the [[Manarai Hills]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
The home of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Vlaçan Umber]] was located there, at [[17 Gallifrey Lane]].<ref name="sos">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The planet [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/Gallifrey Gallifrey] is an important setting in the British television franchise [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/Doctor_Who ''Doctor Who''].

==Appearances==
*''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''
